name: ep_victim
means: where the pawn taken en passant stands, behind the passed-over square from the capturer's side

why.rust: the Rust core reads it inside shakmaty's move generator: no relation or method of its own
why.lean: no hand-written or kernel definition is this relation: its Lean definition is generated from the spec (76.1 (b), Ideas.Spec.Chess)
why.python: python-chess has no predicate of its own for it (the spec's device, read through the binding gdl_chess.py)
